title: Nehorai ben Shuniya (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of Tosefta Maaserot, reporting Rabbi Shimon; so too in Jerusalem Talmud Maaserot 1:3.
Kesef Mishneh, Hilkhot Maaser 2:8, reads Nehorai bar Shilya.

notes.text: Kesef Mishneh is the ordinary expansion of כ״מ in the context of Hilkhot Maaser. The finite lookup for that commentary reference failed to resolve; no corroboration is claimed. Shuniya and Shilya remain different source forms.
The consulted Tosefta Maasrot has ben Shunia and the Yerushalmi has bar Shinya. The exact Shilya reading attributed to Kesef Mishneh remains Hyman’s report.
